name: Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates and manages fast-food restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company operates gyudon beef bowl restaurants under the Yoshinoya brand; Japanese noodle restaurants under the Hanamaru Udon, Umagena, Sanuki Noodle Restaurant, Tsurusaku, Takamatsu Chokushi, Chikusei, Zuzuzu, Zuzuzu (kishimen), and Hoshigaoka Seimenjo brands; and ramen restaurants under the Setagaya, Hirugao, Fukumori, Oreshiki, Fukumi, Gankuro, The Gyorou, Shinsen, Ramen Hide, Kamiyagura, Bariuma, Torinosuke, Fuunmaru, Buchiton, Kirameki no Tori, and Takara Sangyo brands.
